name: LightCarbon LCR017S-D
why_interesting: The stem-based version of LightCarbon's super-light LCR017 platform keeps the same 870 g size-52 frame while allowing a replaceable 10-degree stem.
missing: Current mainland quote, selected package, delivery and warranty route
price_status: Historical owner-reported US$555 frame quotation converted to CNY; exact official page remains quote-only on 2026-09-23 and current mainland checkout is unverified

facts.frame: LCR017S-D super-light road disc frameset with separate stem
facts.frame_material: Toray T700, T800 and T1000 carbon
facts.frame_construction: 3D latex-mandrel monocoque with full internal routing
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-52 frame; 850–945 g across six sizes, ±30 g; fork 390 g ±15 g; seatpost 160 g ±10 g
facts.cockpit: Separate 10-degree carbon stem in 90, 100, 110 or 120 mm
facts.geometry: Reach 371–402.1 mm; stack 502.6–582.9 mm; 410 mm chainstays; 70 mm BB drop; 57.4–68.1 mm trail
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer process claim only; no independent exact-model stiffness measurement recorded
facts.manufacturer package: Current manufacturer package: frame, fork, seatpost, clamp, headset, spacers, thru-axles and stem. T47 bottom bracket is a paid option, excluded by default; this does not establish the historical quoted package.
facts.chainring compatibility: Manufacturer maxima: Shimano 2x 55–42T / 1x 46T; SRAM 2x 56–43T / 1x 58T. Confirm exact crank and chainline before assembly.
